shape: Each cycle spawns /bin/sh -c 'cat <&3 >&4' with stdio ['ignore','ignore','pipe','pipe','pipe'], round-trips, destroys stdio[3]/stdio[4], drops the reference; then spawns a victim the same way, takes an fstat-only fd census, optionally Bun.gc(true) / global.gc(), censuses again, and round-trips the victim with a 3 s limit.

results.outcome: every run: cycle 2 GC closed the live victim's socket fds 6 and 8; victim round trip timed out with nothing received
18/18 cycles clean, nothing closed across GC

upstream: Matches oven-sh/bun#30443 (Playwright five-pipe Chromium crashes after 7-12 launches); fixed by oven-sh/bun#32520 (extra stdio index >= 3 mapped to socket-fd so finalize_streams never double-closes), first released in bun-v1.4.0.
scope: Proves the Bun <= 1.3.14 extra-stdio double close in isolation. Does not by itself prove the Relic PATH or boundary failures are this mechanism; that is the job of the in-situ gc-probe run.
